
I would like you to reverse engineer a gate-level netlist back to its original RTL description.
The netlist was synthesized from a Verilog RTL design.

Please create an equivalent, clean, and readable RTL description that implements the same functionality.
Your RTL should be written in standard Verilog or SystemVerilog using best practices.

The module should be named 'TopModule' with the following interface:
clk, resetn, in, out

Gate-level netlist:
```verilog

  input clk;
  wire clk;

  output out;
  wire out;
  input resetn;
  wire resetn;
  wire [3:0] sr;
  NAND _08_ (
    .A(resetn),
    .B(sr[0]),
    .Y(_05_)
  );
  NOT _09_ (
    .A(_05_),
    .Y(_01_)

  NAND _10_ (
    .A(resetn),
    .B(sr[1]),
    .Y(_06_)

  NOT _11_ (
    .A(_06_),
    .Y(_02_)

  NAND _12_ (
    .A(resetn),

  NOT _13_ (
    .A(_07_),

  );
  NAND _14_ (
    .A(in),
    .B(resetn),
    .Y(_04_)
  );
  NOT _15_ (
    .A(_04_),
    .Y(_00_)
  );
  DFF _16_ (
    .C(clk),
    .D(_00_),
    .Q(sr[0])
  );
  DFF _17_ (
    .C(clk),
    .D(_01_),
    .Q(sr[1])
  );
  DFF _18_ (
    .C(clk),
    .D(_02_),
    .Q(sr[2])
  );
  DFF _19_ (
    .C(clk),
    .D(_03_),
    .Q(sr[3])

  assign out = sr[3];
```
